code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6,4))
# core
import matplotlib.patches as patches
ax.add_patch(patches.Arc((0.5,0.1),0.8,0.7,theta1=0,theta2=180,lw=2))
# flex facets
xs=[0.18,0.32,0.46,0.54,0.68,0.82]
ys=[0.22,0.35,0.42,0.42,0.35,0.22]
ax.plot(xs,ys,'o-',lw=2)
ax.text(0.5,0.05,'rigid core (fixed)',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.text(0.5,0.48,'silicone dielectric',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.text(0.15,0.25,'flex tail to CDC',fontsize=8)
ax.annotate('',xy=(0.25,0.24),xytext=(0.12,0.22),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'))
ax.text(0.5,0.6,'skin deforms (moving)',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0,1);ax.set_ylim(0,0.7);ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout();plt.savefig('sketch.png')
